description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class for importing translation data into the OrangeHRM system. It handles uploading, validating, processing, and saving XLIFF translation files for specific languages, and includes API documentation annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI.

classes.name: I18NTranslationImportAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for importing internationalization translation files into a specific language within OrangeHRM, handling file validation, processing, and database storage.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Method intended to retrieve all entries, but not implemented in this API endpoint.

methods.description: Returns validation rules for 'getAll' method, not implemented.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles uploading and processing of an XLIFF translation file, updating translation strings in the database, managing transactions, and returning success/failure counts.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create method, including language ID existence and correct base64 attachment format.
